    """Intersect the two non-separator panels and mark overlaps with color 2."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A full-width uniform line separates stacked panels.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if 0 < r < h - 1 and len(set(row)) == 1:
            top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            if len(top) == len(bottom):
                return [[2 if top[i][j] != 0 and bottom[i][j] != 0 else 0
                         for j in range(w)] for i in range(len(top))]
    # A full-height uniform line separates side-by-side panels.
    for c in range(1, w - 1):
        if len({grid[i][c] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and c == w - c - 1:
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            return [[2 if left[i][j] != 0 and right[i][j] != 0 else 0
                     for j in range(c)] for i in range(h)]
    raise ValueError("No centered uniform separator found")

src='''def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the two equal-sized panels split by a uniform divider."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Horizontal divider.
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0:
            top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            if len(top) == len(bottom) and all(len(x) == w for x in top + bottom):
                return [[2 if top[i][j] != 0 and bottom[i][j] != 0 else 0
                         for j in range(w)] for i in range(len(top))]
    # Vertical divider.
    for c in range(1, w - 1):
        if all(grid[i][c] == grid[0][c] != 0 for i in range(h)):
            left_w, right_w = c, w - c - 1
            if left_w == right_w:
                return [[2 if grid[i][j] != 0 and grid[i][c + 1 + j] != 0 else 0
                         for j in range(left_w)] for i in range(h)]
    raise ValueError("No matching panels separated by a uniform nonzero line")
'''
